label: Razorpay payments export
notes: Only captured or refunded payments are read; failed and authorised-only attempts are skipped.
Razorpay's fee already includes the GST shown in tax, so payment_fee_inr = fee.
Dashboard CSV exports show rupees. API (JSON) exports are in paise: divide by 100 before uploading.
A refund_status of partial or full counts as returned.
Email (or phone) is hashed into customer_id; the value itself is not stored.
